source.title: High-dose intravenous vitamin C, a promising multi-targeting agent in the treatment of cancer
source.journal: Journal of Experimental & Clinical Cancer Research
source.design: narrative review with targeted literature searches for selected preclinical and clinical subsets
source.source_scope_warning: This review summarizes heterogeneous preclinical and clinical literature. Results from cited studies are secondary reports and should be checked in the primary publications before reuse as primary evidence.

source_integrity_findings: The Acknowledgements state that the work was supported by Dutch Cancer Society project grant 10212 to C.R.J., while the separate Funding section states "Not applicable." Both statements are preserved without reconciliation.
Trial counts and ongoing-trial status are time-bound to the authors' 2021 review period and were not externally updated.
